guideTitle: The Best HP and Dell Docking Stations for Business Laptops
breadcrumbLabel: Best Docks for HP and Dell Laptops
metaTitle: Best Docking Stations for HP and Dell Laptops: G5, G6 and WD22TB4 (2026)
metaDescription: We compared HP G5 and G6 USB-C docks and Dell WD22TB4 Thunderbolt 4 docks, new and renewed, on charging wattage, connection type, condition and price.
introParagraphs: If you use an HP EliteBook, ProBook or ZBook, or a Dell Latitude or Precision, the manufacturer's own dock is often the simplest choice: it is designed around those laptops, and IT departments often already support it. This guide compares HP's G5 and G6 USB-C docks with Dell's WD22TB4 Thunderbolt 4 dock.

The main differences are charging wattage (match it to your laptop's charger), connection type (HP's docks here are USB-C; Dell's WD22TB4 is Thunderbolt 4), and condition, since several listings are renewed units at lower prices.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $62 to $255 at the time of writing.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11-in-1.summary: HP's 11-in-1 G5 business USB-C dock, new.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11-in-1.description:
The HP USB-C Dock G5 is the sensible default for HP business laptops: an 11-in-1 USB-C dock that HP designs for EliteBook, ZBook and ProBook models, with multiple display outputs, for about $98 new at the time of writing.

The listing does not state its charging wattage; check it against your laptop's charger. The renewed version costs about $36 less.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11-in-1.skipIf: You are comfortable with renewed; the renewed G5 costs less.

hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.badge: Best HP Dock for Higher Wattage
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.summary: HP's current G6 USB-C dock with 100W power delivery.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.description:
The HP G6 is HP's current business dock with 100W power delivery, for HP laptops that need more charging power, designed for EliteBook, ZBook and ProBook lines.

It costs about $195 at the time of writing, twice the G5.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.bestFor: HP laptops with higher charging needs.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.skipIf: The G5 meets your laptop's wattage.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5-charging-bundle-renewed.summary: A renewed HP G5 dock bundled with a charging accessory.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-charging-bundle-renewed.description:
This is a renewed HP G5 bundled with a charging accessory, for about $135 at the time of writing.

That is more than a new G5 costs at the time of writing, so it only makes sense if you need the included charger.
cons: Costs more than a new G5
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-charging-bundle-renewed.bestFor: Buyers who need the bundled charger.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-charging-bundle-renewed.skipIf: You have a charger; the new G5 is cheaper.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5-renewed.summary: A renewed HP G5 dock for about $62.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-renewed.description:
The renewed HP G5 is the cheapest dock here at about $62 at the time of writing, the same 11-port business dock in refurbished condition.

Check the renewed warranty terms before buying.

hp-usb-c-g5-essential-dock.summary: HP's G5 Essential dock with a streamlined port set.
hp-usb-c-g5-essential-dock.description:
The G5 Essential is HP's streamlined business dock with a smaller port set than the full G5, for about $106 at the time of writing.

At that price it costs more than the full G5 at the time of writing, so check what each is selling for.
cons: Fewer ports than the G5 but costs more at the time of writing
hp-usb-c-g5-essential-dock.bestFor: Buyers who find it cheaper than the full G5 when ordering.

dell-thunderbolt-wd22tb4-dock-130w.summary: Dell's WD22TB4 Thunderbolt 4 dock with 130W charging.
dell-thunderbolt-wd22tb4-dock-130w.description:
The Dell WD22TB4 is Dell's Thunderbolt 4 dock; this version supplies 130W, enough for many Dell business laptops, for about $185 at the time of writing.

It works best with Thunderbolt-equipped Dell laptops.
dell-thunderbolt-wd22tb4-dock-130w.bestFor: Dell Latitude and similar Thunderbolt laptops.
dell-thunderbolt-wd22tb4-dock-130w.skipIf: Your Dell needs more than 130W; choose the 180W version.

dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-4-dock-180w-new.summary: The 180W WD22TB4 for higher-draw Dell laptops such as Precision workstations.
dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-4-dock-180w-new.description: The 180W WD22TB4 is the version for higher-power Dell laptops, such as Precision workstations, that need more charging than 130W, sold new, for about $255 at the time of writing.
dell-wd22tb4-thunderbolt-4-dock-180w-new.bestFor: Dell Precision and other high-draw laptops.

wd22tb4-dell-thunderbolt-4-dock-40gbps.summary: A WD22TB4 listing highlighting 40Gbps, PXE network boot and Dell approval.
wd22tb4-dell-thunderbolt-4-dock-40gbps.description:
This WD22TB4 listing highlights full 40Gbps Thunderbolt 4 bandwidth, network boot (PXE) support for IT deployment, and inclusion on Dell's approved hardware list, for about $245 at the time of writing.

The listing does not state which wattage version it is; confirm 130W or 180W before ordering.
wd22tb4-dell-thunderbolt-4-dock-40gbps.skipIf: You are a single user; the 130W version is cheaper.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Match your laptop's charger. HP G6: 100W; Dell WD22TB4: 130W or 180W.
HP's docks here are USB-C; the Dell is Thunderbolt 4 and suits Thunderbolt-equipped laptops.
Renewed docks cost less; check the warranty.
Manufacturer docks are often already supported by company IT.

faq.q: Will an HP dock work with a Dell laptop, or the reverse?
faq.a: Often for basic functions over USB-C or Thunderbolt, but features like charging wattage and firmware management are designed around the maker's own laptops.

faq.q: Is a renewed dock worth it?
faq.a: It can save a lot. Check the renewed warranty and return terms.
At least your laptop charger's wattage; check the label on your charger.

bottomLine: For HP business laptops, the G5 is the sensible default, the renewed G5 is the budget route, and the G6 suits higher-wattage models.
For Dell, choose the WD22TB4 by wattage: 130W for most business laptops, 180W for Precision workstations.
